analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: When you view on-demand video on our websites, we may collect your viewing and usage information, and we may share information that identifies you as having viewed particular video content with service providers that enable video functionality, personalization, and usage analysis and third parties for advertising and marketing, as well as editorial purposes.

analysis.headline: Shares for Targeted Ads
analysis.quote: With your consent, we may occasionally run online advertising activities targeting you specifically by utilising personal information you have shared with us, namely your email address. This allows us to advertise in the most relevant way, promoting products, services and opportunities that we deem beneficial to you. The legal basis for this processing is Article 6 sec. 1 sent. 1 lit. a GDPR, consent to the use of your email address for this purpose, including its transfer to third party advertising platforms.

analysis.headline: Your Data Leaves Your Country
analysis.quote: Your personal data may be disclosed to third parties (see X) that might be located outside your country of residence; potentially, different data protection standards may apply (see XI).

analysis.headline: Collects Extensive Conference Data
analysis.quote: This includes data categories such as: Identification data (which may include name, address, telephone number, email address), entity type (e.g. academic, government, industry), position titles, curriculum vitaes, professional license information, dietary requirements, gender, information for travel arrangements (i.e., passport data, date of birth) and payment information. We also request information relating to requirements for reasonable accommodation where physical assistance may be needed to attend.

analysis.headline: Uses AI for Customer Service
analysis.quote: We may use generative AI to support us in providing the response or service requested; any output is subject to human oversight before being used.

analysis.headline: Retains Financial Data 10 Years
analysis.quote: By statutory law we are required to retain the provided financial data in relation to transactions (including address, payment and order information) for ten years.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Reading History
analysis.quote: We use Permutive cookie data to recommend relevant content to you based on your reading history.

analysis.headline: Creates Profile from Public Data
analysis.quote: Create a profile of your publication record based on publicly available data, such as published books and articles, citations and grants awarded.

analysis.headline: Aggregates Your Data from Others
analysis.quote: Springer Nature may process personal data collected by research data aggregators such as ORCID in order to validate or supplement the publication records we hold to support the Researcher Profiles on link.springer.com.
